UP CM Links Krishna Janmabhoomi Issue to Politics, Targets Opposition

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has linked the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi issue to state politics, using it to target opposition leader Akhilesh Yadav. The Chief Minister's move is seen as a political maneuver combining Jat community outreach and Hindutva agendas, particularly in the Jatland region. This development suggests the Krishna Janmabhoomi issue could become a significant factor in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections, shifting the political focus from Ayodhya to Mathura.
